newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel climbs on results, restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel climbs on results, restructuring.

text.p: Shares in Alsthom Alcatel jumped on Tuesday, as the market welcomed the 1996 net attributable profit figure announced this morning and confirmation that the engineering group's restructuring was well under way, traders said.
"The market is buying into the story that Alcatel is gradually being restructured...and is rewarding (chairman) Serge Tchuruk," a broker said.
Alcatel firmed 2.12 percent to 626 francs on volume of 406,190 shares at 1040 GMT.
Net attributable profit, at 2.7 billion francs, exceeded the company's own forecast 2.5 billion.
Reasons to be cheerful included the group's debt reduction, a pickup in order books and the company's aim of improving operating margins, even though the latter would need some time, a broker said.
The company had also appeared to have prepared the ground for its bid in the Thomson-CSF privatisation and if it won, this would not weigh on the stock price, he added.
Alcatel has teamed up with Dassault Industries to bid together for Thomson-CSF, which would bring in combat plane maker Dassault Aviation.
Another market professional said of Alcatel's results, "The operating profit is quite encouraging."
